scope: Twenty overlapping documentary case records from thirty selected logical chats; not independent trials or model failure rates.
evidence_note: Selected excerpts are contained in the cited record. Reviewer descriptions paraphrase or summarize visible messages, tool results or lifecycle records. Hashes refer to original private JSONL record bytes including line terminators, not public text.

cases.title: Trading objective replaced with policy imitation and an unreachable execution gate
cases.finding: The trainer advanced authored-policy compliance, optimizer updates and review completion as progress toward economic capability. Its retained source review reported a BUY gate requiring PnL readiness True while the collector always emitted False, and 197/200 early authored rows had inconsistent relative-return inputs. This is a concrete implementation and target-design problem, not evidence that GPT-OSS chose HOLD or that OpenAI trained a psychological reluctance to trade.
cases.outcome_or_impact: Repeated training versions and technical preparation did not establish the requested economic capability or a working paper-trading round trip. A human had to request explicit critical reviews and simpler outcome-based milestones.
cases.limits: Type-1 quote error 354 alone does not prove a Type-3 failure; market hours and user-prescribed irreversible-stop rules are genuine boundaries. The current V9 task is still active, so snapshot incompleteness is not an autonomous final halt. The frozen PnL path was not independently rerun in this audit; this is documentary evidence of the trainer review.
cases.context_assessment: Goal drift and inconsistent producer/consumer contracts are established. Internal memory loss or compaction causation is not established.

cases.title: Active repair was dropped after a status question immediately following compaction
cases.finding: After managers reported quarantined submissions, the Stack task promised to implement acknowledgement and evidence-bound recovery, publish releases, commission and resolve safe states. Its audit identified obsolete EtradeOnly defaults and a discarded callback request ID. A human status question about an unresolved command arrived during that work. At 00:25:16 MYT July 24, context compacted; the very next final response simply answered the status question, and the task ended with the broader repair uncommissioned. The next-day message says another owner deployed the resolver and fixed the obsolete IBAPI attributes.
cases.outcome_or_impact: A 91-minute repair turn ended on a narrow status answer, leaving the promised deployment and commissioning to another task. This shows the repair ended with a status answer while the broader objective remained unfinished; timing does not isolate a causal mechanism.
cases.limits: The original task prohibited broker mutations and test orders. Do not criticize absence of real order placement in its initial commissioning. Refusing literal erasure of an uncertain command was prudent; the model-caused problem is abandonment of already-authorized local repair/deployment work.
cases.context_assessment: Exact temporal association: compaction at 00:25:16 MYT, final at 00:25:33 MYT, task_complete in the same turn. The compacted summary is encrypted, so we cannot establish whether it omitted the active plan, whether the model forgot it, or whether prioritization failed despite retaining it. The replacement history retained the broader objectives as readable user messages; omission or erasure of them is not established.

The first Deep repair passed165 tests, then independent review found four further gaps (primaryExchange omission, fill high-water protection, audit-linked terminal proof, and waiting for complete reconciliation streams). Actual SDK-object integration tests were added afterward.
cases.outcome_or_impact: The corrected Deep candidate reached297 passing tests and a sealed handoff, but fresh Manager functional acceptance/Owner commissioning were still outstanding at the selected-history cutoff. AI likewise had a revised tested candidate while its order remained unresolved. Quota errors occurred during this period; ongoing work at cutoff cannot alone be labeled unexplained abandonment.
cases.limits: An empty open-order snapshot is not terminal proof, and ownership/reservation controls must not be bypassed. The blocking control was legitimate; the handling of genuine SDK terminal evidence was defective. Originating authorship of old adapter code is not established by current Astra turn metadata.
